messages:
marta_support: FYI customer hitting 400 on POST /v1/rerank in prod-us-east. Payload attached. Ticket SUP-421 :eyes:

simon_customer: here's the exact JSON the client is sending (copied from their request):
```json
{
  "request_id": "cust-421",
  "queries": [
    {
      "id": 123,
      "text": "Which is better for user search?",
      "top_k": "5",
      "candidates": [101, 102, 103]
    }
  ]
}
```

ci-bot: ingest: request-received id=cust-421 status=400 parse-error=validation_failed

raj_engineer: quick glance — two separate validation problems here: 1) top_k is a string ("5") but the API expects an integer. 2) candidates is an array of numeric ids; the rerank schema expects an array of objects like {"id": "str", "text": "str"}. The server currently returns a generic 400, which is confusing.

marta_support: I reproduced this locally with the exact payload and got the same 400. Customer is on our Node SDK 2.5.0 + a legacy querystring middleware. Looks like top_k got stringified by a wrapper. Workaround for them: cast top_k to a number and send full candidate objects (id as string, include text) — that fixed it in my local test.

raj_engineer: repro curl for triage: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"request_id":"cust-421","queries":[{"id":123,"text":"Which is better for user search?","top_k":5,"candidates":[{"id":"101","text":"Candidate A"},{"id":"102","text":"Candidate B"}]}]}'
```

raj_engineer: server error body we returned for the original bad payload (for reference):
```json
{
  "error": "Bad Request",
  "message": "validation failed: top_k must be integer; candidates must be non-empty array of objects with id and text",
  "code": 400
}
```

marta_support: Customer confirmed they can switch to objects and that fixes it. They asked for a clearer error message so their engineers can self-serve.

raj_engineer: I'll open a small server patch to make the 400 error include field-level details (which field, expected type, and path). Also logging improvement so we can surface the offending JSON snippet in internal logs (sanitized). Punting on accepting numeric-only candidate ids until eng-ml weighs in on compatibility / downstream scoring assumptions.

marta_support: Created escalation SUP-421-ESCL, assigned to raj_engineer. ETA for better error message: ~48 hours. Interim: document workaround (cast top_k to int, send candidate objects).

simon_customer: Thanks — pls keep us posted, they want an ETA before EOD.

marta_support: Will do. Closing loop once patch merges and doc note published. :white_check_mark:
